primary_text: "Every time we bid on something a developer swoops in and outbids us by 200k." The auction market is rigged against small business. Developers see land value. You see a place to run your business. That's why our Truganina warehouses are sold at fixed pricing, off the plan, with owner-occupiers first in line. No auction stress. No being outbid at the last second. Secure your unit with a deposit and settle on completion. Located right off Princes Freeway in Melbourne's western industrial corridor, near Port of Melbourne. Stop competing. Start owning.
description: Fixed off-the-plan pricing means no auctions and no surprise bids from developers.
